raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "spint" %}
{% set version = "1.1.0" %}
{% set python_min = "3.12" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/spint-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 33fec949d9ac1bb258dac8599f33cd3e9c70af241938fa49312ec8ac7cf116ea

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools >=61.0
    - setuptools-scm >=6.2
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - libpysal >=4.0.0
    - numpy >=1.3
    - scipy >=0.11
    - spglm >=1.0.6
    - spreg

test:
  imports:
    - spint
    - spint.tests
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: http://pysal.org/
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_family: BSD
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: 'Efficient calibration of spatial interaction models in Python'

  description: |
    The Spatial Interaction Modeling (SpInt) module provides a collection of
    tools to study spatial interaction processes and analyze spatial
    interaction data.
  doc_url: https://spint.readthedocs.io/
  dev_url: http://github.com/pysal/spint

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jGaboardi
    - knaaptime
    - martinfleis
    - TaylorOshan
    - ocefpaf
